title: Livid Vanilla
description: The greatest Vanilla plus resource pack you can find!
body:
Livid Vanilla was a project designed to simply update textures that never recieved them in the texture update, but now it covers additional texture features and other cool things; variation, texture updates, references, many flowers.

[Livid Specifics, of the many texture changes I've created for this pack, some I've yet to see in others (partly because theyre tedious), but I pressed forward however boring they might've been.]

Features:
Livid Specific: Longer Swords & 2d Tridents:
![the longer sword in the pack, making use of the spear's item functions.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23fb6f6ee9edd3921941fa61fd8b41d874848a1a.png)
![Me with the 2d trident and longer sword :)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fb62ff31181ff71816bbc87429682227314eacb2.png)

Double Slab Textures:
![Double slab textures for all your building needs.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1df394137668935e2946ac9cc49de377b206317b.png)

Variated Flowers:
![Variated Poppies and Wither Roses.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/99b4a48dcd774b69fdb11ab31c9624baafec1898.png)
![Dandelions and Blue Orchids.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/501f8c224a8444b592abb7cdcf513ad8ee7c5eb9.png)

Dungeons and Beta Jappa Variations:
(during the texture update and future updates afterwards, Jappa made several variations of each texture until Mojang came to the ones we have now, quite a few end up looking really natural as variations. Dungeons however was developed in the midst of the update, having various versions of textures scattered throughout the game, so they fit quite nicely)
![Amethyst and Andesite (both beta Jappa textures).](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b77ce501a3603d38c11777f3b3b2c27170236ce_0.webp)
![Calcite(Texture Update), Chiseled Nether Brick (Dungeons), Cobblestone (Both), Polished Cracked Blackstone Bricks (Dungeons).](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19caf914c04f934c6bbe13bfa94fa5b5322151fc.png)
![Mossy Cobblestone (Texture Update), Mossy Bricks (Dungeons), Wart Block (Dungeons), Netherrack (Texture Update).](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0dab75c9ddf729840b48a3e4c8b9877ae70918e3.png)

References:
(Inspiration is what I love) Blue Tulip (Caelesti), Old Gravel (Vintage).
![Blue Tulip (Caelesti), Old Gravel (Vintage).](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4516473c92459880c365db12ac85a5b62824563.png)

Livid Specific: Door Textures:
One of the lesser known things about the door textures, they use the same one for every face, which ends up giving you hinges where the door opens. But not anymore.
![Various doors, don't worry, it's all of them.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df9a48b5280ffb9956dea2ceb3d7d2902a1771e4.png)

There are of course many other features are apparent, and not everything is finalized and can always be changed later, looking at you sunflower.
